items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So there I was playing with Phil Markowitz from… I knew from Rochester... And the drummer was Joe LaBarbera... We played with Phil Markowitz.

ctx.x: And… “Toots, we have a new engagement, new contract with Warner Bros. and we’d like you to come and play two songs,” something like that, with, on the session. And I said… I answered right away. “Yes, but before you confirm that then really, you have to come… I was playing at the, with the quartet at a jazz club called Hoppers. That was… here’s the Village Vanguard, and 200 yards on the other side of the street was Hoppers. So there I was playing with Phil Markowitz from… I knew from Rochester, you know. And the…
